stopRule: No automatic retry or replacement. Save every completed request before validation; stop on cancellation, generation/validation failure, memory warning, lifecycle interruption, Low Power Mode, or non-nominal thermal state. Preserve partial files.
analysisRule: Execute only the two previously unexecuted longer-context requests, in the original 576 then 512 MiB order. Preserve this follow-up as a separate two-request memory characterization, linked to the stopped parent attempt; do not relabel or complete the parent's failed 14-run record. Compare exact prompt/output IDs and stop flags. Report each request's sampled memory, baseline/end readings, gaps and environment, with no statistical latency, energy, or context-scaling claim from this single pair. Record the new executable identity; do not pool timing across builds.

prompts.text: Read these repeated notes carefully. In two sentences, summarize what is stated about cache hits and cold filesystem caches.
prompts.repeatedContext: The expert cache stores a changing subset of model weights in memory. A cache hit avoids an expert payload read. Clearing this cache does not clear the operating system's filesystem cache.
